scene: You climb into a breezy rooftop garden.
picture: Along the rooftop floor, the open ladder hatch sits on the far left. The young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands left of centre. A glowing cat rests on a bench on the left, a luminous fruit tree grows in the centre, and a plank bridges rightward.
